ModMetaData.name: 边防岗哨 Watch Posts
ModMetaData.author: ColonySeries
ModMetaData.description:
Watch posts (downgraded from full night-roster HR). Build 1–3 posts; at night a colonist stands watch.
Manned: early raid warning (+0.5–1.5h letter) and faster fire notice. Empty: weaker night fire awareness only.
NEVER auto-unlocks doors. NEVER raises raid points. Not a duty-roster UI — just posts.
岗哨建筑（由「边防更鼓」降级）。夜间有人站岗 → 袭击预警与更快火灾发现；空岗仅减弱火灾察觉。绝不自动开门、绝不提高袭击点数。
